gold_evidence: Zu einer Verarbeitung oder Nutzung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten kommt es, sofern Sie freiwillig Ihre personenbezogenen Daten angeben.
note: Purposes listed: contract/inquiries, newsletter, disclosure to authorities, advertising/market research (chunk 1).

This is the real gap: legal basis is cited for Google Analytics specifically (Art. 6 Abs. 1 S. 1 lit. f), but never for the site's own primary processing -- contract handling, newsletter, advertising. A generic 'if you provide data voluntarily' framing, not a legal basis.
No statement of a legitimate interest for the site's own processing (only Google Analytics' Art 6(1)(f) basis is named, and even that doesn't spell out what the interest actually is).

Genuinely missing. Data portability is a GDPR-specific right with no equivalent in the old BDSG this notice is otherwise written against -- consistent with the whole document predating GDPR's rollout.
